465-585-647-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1681-4140-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1681-4140-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-7199-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1978-2392-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.

2021-2060-5902-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6774-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Loading Zone
Repeat.

2092-2757-5140-6826.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2092-2757-5140-6826.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Masked Meower from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Masked Meower, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-3644-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2921-3644-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1170-2642-4050-7523.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Landscape Painter // Vibrant Idea, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

1628-3490-3698-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-3490-3698-7426.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat

1387-1500-2633-2871-7425.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

5256-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5256-7084-7316.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

779-4668-4970-5751.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
779-4668-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1887-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1418-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

2645-6474-6984.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control at least five creatures.
2645-6474-6984.description:
Activate the creature with Staff of Domination attached using Evendo, Waking Haven's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least six {G}
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-6474-6984.notes: You can use Evendo, Waking Haven's station ability to put the charge counters on the creature. You can also notably use a Spacecraft for a similar effect.

1115-1170-1329-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

431-2557-3129-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-3129-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

914-3036-6791.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-6791.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2707-5751-6504-6595.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2440-5220-5231-6456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Dragons, one of which must be nontoken and have mana value 8 or less.
2440-5220-5231-6456.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 8 or less, adding {R}.
When the Dragon dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the Dragon from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Breaching Dragonstorm by paying {4}{R}.
When Breaching Dragonstorm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to exile the Dragon from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Breaching Dragonstorm's second ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Breaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Repeat.

539-1251-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-1251-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

618-3967-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

678-2397-4050-4151.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-2397-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

369-2730-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

712-1562-3995.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Horseshoe Crab that is an artifact.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Wake Thrasher triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

3338-3772-4009-4331.notablePrerequisites:
Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifacts.
3338-3772-4009-4331.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Omen Hawker.
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other creature using Mirran Spy.

2201-3931.description:
Godhead of Awe causes all other creatures to have base power and toughness of 1/1.
Ascendant Evincar gives all nonblack creatures -1/-1.
Any nonblack creatures will enter the battlefield as a 0/0 creature, and will die as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.

1806-2034-2382-3943.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
 Faldorn triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2178-2857.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2034-2178-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness. You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2034-2178-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

65-717-864-875-2628.description:
Activate Fetid Pools's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Fetid Pools, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Fetid Pools trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Fetid Pools from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
